sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner is insisting on adjournment without giving any proper justification for adjournment.

There is a stay on the infrastructure project of the State Government on the instance of the petitioner, which was granted on 19.9.2019 though the case was taken up for the first time on 22.10.2018 when only the notices were issued.
The Apex Court in M/s.N.G.Projects Limited versus M/s.Vinod Kumar Jain & Others 2022 LiveLaw (SC) 302 has held that infrastructure projects should not be withheld.

entities.text: M/s.N.G.Projects Limited versus M/s.Vinod Kumar Jain & Others 2022 LiveLaw (SC) 302
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In case it is found that the petitioner's land was wrongfully acquired or he was not given compensation then he can be compensated in terms of money i.e. monetary consideration will govern the aspect of land acquisition.
From the rejoinder, it is evident that notice was issued by the Sub Divisional Officer and Land Acquisition Officer-Pali, District Umaria on 22.8.2019.
Thereafter, the petitioner had made a representation Annexure P/10, which is undated.

In view of such fact, once proceedings have been initiated under Section 21 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013,
the stay order granted by a Coordinate Bench of this Hon'ble High Court earlier is causing hindrance in proceeding with the said notice as has been filed by the petitioner, which is prior to the date of grant of interim order passed by a Coordinate Bench of this Court on 19.9.2019 and, therefore, since proceedings have been initiated in terms of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, the petitioner will be free to take steps in accordance with law and the stay for the reason stated above that infrastructure projects cannot be withheld especially when a party can be compensated in monetary term, is vacated.
Accordingly, this writ petition is disposed of with liberty to the petitioner to take steps in accordance with the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
(VIVEK AGARWAL) JUDGE amit Dr. Parikshit Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151019679/

There is a stay on the infrastructure project of the State Government on the instance of the petitioner, which was granted on 19.9.2019 though the case was taken up for the first time on 22.10.2018 when only the notices were issued.
From the rejoinder, it is evident that notice was issued by the Sub Divisional Officer and Land Acquisition Officer-Pali, District Umaria on 22.8.2019.
Thereafter, the petitioner had made a representation Annexure P/10, which is undated.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
The Apex Court in M/s.N.G.Projects Limited versus M/s.Vinod Kumar Jain & Others 2022 LiveLaw (SC) 302 has held that infrastructure projects should not be withheld.
In case it is found that the petitioner's land was wrongfully acquired or he was not given compensation then he can be compensated in terms of money i.e. monetary consideration will govern the aspect of land acquisition.
In view of such fact, once proceedings have been initiated under Section 21 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013,
the stay order granted by a Coordinate Bench of this Hon'ble High Court earlier is causing hindrance in proceeding with the said notice as has been filed by the petitioner, which is prior to the date of grant of interim order passed by a Coordinate Bench of this Court on 19.9.2019 and, therefore, since proceedings have been initiated in terms of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, the petitioner will be free to take steps in accordance with law and the stay for the reason stated above that infrastructure projects cannot be withheld especially when a party can be compensated in monetary term, is vacated.
Accordingly, this writ petition is disposed of with liberty to the petitioner to take steps in accordance with the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
